description: Covers how to apply the FAIR principles - findable, accessible, interoperable, reusable - to research software, and how to assess a project's FAIRness. Use when the user asks how to make software FAIR, wants help with findability, discoverability, or software reuse, mentions metadata, persistent identifiers, DOIs, registries, or software citation in a FAIR context, or asks to run a FAIR self-assessment or checklist on a repository. (Automated FAIR4RS scoring, compliance levels and CI gates with the FAIRGuard tool are rseng-fairguard; FAIR for ML models and datasets is rseng-fair-ml; finding existing software to reuse is rseng-software-reuse.)
